response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), h AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) OVER () AS OverallAvg FROM g) SELECT MediaTypeName, AvgUnitPrice, AvgBytesPerMs, AvgBytesPerMs / OverallAvg AS RatioToOverallAvg FROM h WHERE OverallAvg IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The 'plain average across the media types' is the unweighted mean of the per-media-type average bytes-per-millisecond values (media types with a missing average are ignored). It is not the average over all qualifying tracks.
Bytes ÷ Milliseconds uses real (non-integer) division. A Milliseconds value of 0 gives a missing value instead of an error.
Groups are formed by MediaType.Name, as the request says. Media types that share a name would be merged.
